create_skill_zip: create a zip file from a skill directory with optional unique suffix for the SKILL.md name
test_create_skill: test creating a skill via litellm.create_skill with a zip file and display title
test_list_skills: test listing skills via litellm.list_skills with a limit and provider credentials
test_get_skill: test retrieving a specific skill by ID via litellm.get_skill
test_delete_skill: test deleting a skill by ID via litellm.delete_skill and verify the skill_deleted response type
